checks.description: Correct row count and first/last dates and adjusted prices (price tolerance 0.02).
Correct total sample return within 0.05 percentage points.
Correct high/low prices and dates (price tolerance 0.02).
Correct single best/worst daily percentage returns and their ending dates within 0.05 percentage points.
Mean daily return and sample SD both within 0.05 percentage points of reference.
Annualized volatility within 0.15 percentage points of reference using sqrt(252).
Correct longest up/down streak lengths and start/end dates using the defined change-count convention.
Correct maximum drawdown within 0.05 percentage points and correct peak/trough dates.
Correct total-return/annualized-volatility ratio within 0.02; does not mislabel it an annualized Sharpe ratio.
Requested three sections, at most 650 words, cautious evidence-based interpretation recognizing the short sample; no invented external explanations.
